text.card: A red giant 3,452 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 1.03 solar masses and 11.2 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,902 K at its surface.
